risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has implemented cybersecurity measures with a Vice President of Information Security and Privacy reporting to the Audit Committee, but cyberattack risks remain. Threat monitoring, risk assessments, and security control testing are conducted regularly.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risk, particularly with Kaplan's international operations representing 22% of revenue. A 10% change in exchange rates could impact operating income by $37 million.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has fixed and variable rate debt, exposing it to interest rate fluctuation risks. A 100 basis point increase in interest rates could increase interest expenses by $4.3 million.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risk, particularly related to Kaplan's operations. Legal disputes may impact the company's reputation and financial results.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risk, particularly related to Kaplan's operations. Damage to reputation may impact financial performance and customer trust.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risk, particularly with Kaplan's educational operations which are subject to substantial government regulation. Regulatory changes may impact the company's financial results and operations.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to competition risk, particularly in Kaplan's operations and the educational services division. Competition may impact the company's financial results and market share.

ai_positioning.summary: GHC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
